overview: A price configuration management UI covering a four-level hierarchy: Price Book, Price Category, Price Header, and Price Item, all sharing a consistent list+tabbed-detail UI pattern per the source requirements.

flows_summary.description: Price Book → Price Category → Price Header → Price Item (drill-down chain)

component_notes: All four screens share list-toolbar, record-list, detail-tabs (4-tab), and field--readonly patterns. SCR-102/103/104 additionally share a cascading-filter pattern.
design_rationale_highlights: One consistent layout pattern reused across all four screens, matching the source's own repeated description
Deepest cascading filter chain (Book->Category->Header->Price Area) on Price Item screen reflects R-717's multi-level dependency
Two Price Item fields rendered with a visible [REVIEW NEEDED] marker rather than a guessed name
